content.content:
1	# ConvertScan (CROBOT)
2	
3	AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with specific AI-generated suggestions to boost conversions.
4	
5	## Stack
6	- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
7	- **Backend**: Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL + Edge Functions + Storage)
8	- **AI**: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) for Vision + Text analysis
9	- **Billing**: Dodo Payments (subscriptions)
10	- **Email**: Resend
11	- **Performance**: Google PageSpeed Insights API
12	- **Screenshots**: Puppeteer service on Railway
13	
14	## Architecture
15	- SPA (Vite) — no SSR. All backend logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno runtime)
16	- Auth: Supabase Auth (Google OAuth + email/password)
17	- Database: PostgreSQL via Supabase with RLS on every table
18	- Storage: Supabase Storage for screenshots
19	- Edge Functions: Deno runtime, import from URLs (not npm)
20	
21	## Pricing Tiers (4-tier model)
22	- **Free**: 3 scans/month, basic score, top 3 suggestions
23	- **Starter** ($29/mo): 5 scans, all suggestions, basic PDF
24	- **Growth** ($49/mo): 25 scans, AI rewrites, PDF, monitoring, benchmarks
25	- **Pro** ($99/mo): Unlimited scans, everything in Growth + team workspaces (3 seats), API, integrations
26	- **Agency** ($199/mo): Unlimited scans, white-label, 10 seats, client portal, bulk processing, API
27	
28	## The 7 CRO Pillars
29	1. Value Proposition (18% weight)
30	2. CTA Effectiveness (20% weight)
31	3. Trust Signals (17% weight)
32	4. Visual Hierarchy (12% weight)
33	5. Mobile Experience (13% weight)
34	6. Content & Copy (11% weight)
35	7. Page Performance (9% weight)
36	
37	## Key Files
38	- `src/App.tsx` — routing, AuthProvider wrapping
39	- `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` — auth state management
40	- `src/pages/Scan.tsx` — core scan submission flow
41	- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — report display with 7 CRO pillars
42	- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — KPI cards, recent scans, charts
43	- `src/hooks/use-scans.ts` — all scan CRUD operations
44	- `src/hooks/use-scan-results.ts` — pillar results queries
45	- `src/hooks/use-billing.ts` — Dodo Payments checkout/portal
46	- `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts` — client-side PDF generation
47	- `src/lib/supabase.ts` — Supabase client
48	- `src/lib/constants.ts` — CRO pillars, weights, plan limits, pricing tiers
49	- `src/lib/score-utils.ts` — scoring algorithm, color mapping
50	- `src/types/index.ts` — all TypeScript types
51	- `src/types/database.ts` — Supabase database types
52	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/` — main scan orchestrator
53	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/prompts.ts` — AI system prompts
54	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/scoring.ts` — scoring engine
55	- `supabase/functions/pagespeed/` — Google PageSpeed integration
56	- `supabase/functions/dodo-checkout/` — Dodo Payments checkout session
57	- `supabase/functions/dodo-webhook/` — Dodo Payments event handler
58	- `supabase/functions/dodo-portal/` — Dodo Payments customer portal
59	- `supabase/functions/send-email/` — Resend email service
60	
61	## Database Tables
62	- `profiles` — user profiles with plan/billing info
63	- `scans` — audit scan records
64	- `scan_results` — per-pillar results with findings JSONB
65	- `integrations` — third-party service connections
66	- `audit_logs` — admin action tracking
67	- `support_tickets` — support system
68	- `feature_flags` — feature toggle system
69	
70	## Commands
71	- `npm run dev` — start dev server (port 8080)
72	- `npm run build` — production build
73	- `npm run lint` — ESLint
74	- `npx supabase functions serve` — local edge functions
75	
76	## Environment Variables
77	### Frontend (.env.local)
78	- VITE_SUPABASE_URL
79	- VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
80	
81	### Supabase Edge Functions (secrets)
82	- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
83	- PAGESPEED_API_KEY
84	- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_URL
85	- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_API_KEY
86	- DODO_API_KEY
87	- DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
88	- DODO_PRODUCT_STARTER_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
89	- DODO_PRODUCT_GROWTH_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
90	- DODO_PRODUCT_PRO_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
91	- DODO_PRODUCT_AGENCY_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
92	- RESEND_API_KEY
93	- SITE_URL
94	
95	## Conventions
96	- All components use shadcn/ui from `@/components/ui/`
97	- Toast notifications via `sonner`
98	- React Query for all server state
99	- Supabase RLS enforces data isolation — no manual auth checks needed in queries
100	- Edge functions return JSON with CORS headers
101	- Findings stored as JSONB arrays in scan_results
102	- Score colors: green (70+), amber (40-69), red (0-39)
103	- Plan gating: use `isPaidPlan(profile.plan)` helper — returns true for starter/growth/pro/agency
104	- Premium feature checks: `isGrowthPlus(plan)` for growth/pro/agency, `isProPlus(plan)` for pro/agency
105	
106	## Sprint Roadmap
107	Full sprint plan: `~/.claude/plans/wondrous-prancing-crescent.md`
108	
109	| Sprint | Weeks | Focus |
110	|--------|-------|-------|
111	| 1 | 1-2 | Foundation: 4-tier pricing, UI polish, dashboard redesign, onboarding |
112	| 2 | 3-4 | Core: AI copy rewrites, score history, re-scan comparison, finding tracker |
113	| 3 | 5-6 | Premium: Competitor comparison, industry benchmarks, shareable links, PDF enhance |
114	| 4 | 7-8 | Agency: Team workspaces, white-label, bulk URL processing |
115	| 5 | 9-10 | API: REST API, Slack, Chrome extension, webhooks |
116	| 6 | 11-12 | Growth: Email sequences, referral program, notifications, SEO pages |
117	| 7 | 13-14 | Analytics: Score monitoring, GA4 integration, Sentry |
118	| 8 | 15-16 | Launch: Performance, accessibility, security, Product Hunt prep |
119	
120	## Agent Hub (UI-only feature)
121	- `src/pages/AgentHub.tsx` and `src/pages/AgentWorkspace.tsx` are UI demo pages
122	- They intentionally use mock data from `src/lib/mock-agents.ts`
123	- The agent engine (`src/lib/agent-engine.ts`) is a client-side simulation — no real backend calls
124	- Do not replace mock data in agent pages without a real backend implementation to replace it with
